> f=open('image.ppm','rb')
> hdr=f.read(15)
> data=f.read()

> # reshape
> px=[data[i:i+3] for i in range(0,len(data),3)]
> print('npix',len(px))
> # row means
> for r in range(0,600,50):
>     row=px[r*800:(r+1)*800]
>     rs=sum(p[0] for p in row)/800
>     gs=sum(p[1] for p in row)/800
>     bs=sum(p[2] for p in row)/800
>     print('row',r,'R',round(rs,1),'G',round(gs,1),'B',round(bs,1))

root@a258f96ffde1:/app# cat > /tmp/grid.py << 'EOF'
> import sys
> f=open('image.ppm','rb')
> f.read(15)
> data=f.read()
> w,h=800,600
> GW,GH=80,60
> def cell(cx,cy):
>     # sum over a GWxGH block
>     xs=cx*GW; ys=cy*GH
>     R=G=B=0;n=0
>     for y in range(ys,min(ys+GH,h)):
>         for x in range(xs,min(xs+GW,w)):
>             o=(y*w+x)*3
>             R+=data[o];G+=data[o+1];B+=data[o+2];n+=1
>     return R//n,G//n,B//n
> for cy in range(GH):
>     row=[]
>     for cx in range(GW):
>         r,g,b=cell(cx,cy)
>         # encode as letter by luminance
>         L=(r+g+b)//3
>         row.append('%3d'%(L))
>     print(''.join(row))
> EOF

root@a258f96ffde1:/app# cat > /tmp/cat.py << 'EOF'
> import sys
> f=open('image.ppm','rb')
> f.read(15)
> data=f.read()
> w,h=800,600
> GW,GH=100,75
> cw,ch=w//GW,h//GH
> def cat(x,y):
>     o=(y*w+x)*3
>     r,g,b=data[o],data[o+1],data[o+2]
>     if b>=250 and r<215 and g<215: return '.'   # sky
>     if r>40 and b<60 and r-b>30: return 'R'      # red sphere
>     mx=max(r,g,b); mn=min(r,g,b)
>     if mx-mn<12:                                  # grayish
>         if mx>130: return '#'  # bright
>         return ':'
>     return '?'
> for cy in range(GH):
>     s=''
>     for cx in range(GW):
>         # sample center of cell
>         xs=cx*cw+cw//2; ys=cy*ch+ch//2
>         s+=cat(xs,ys)
>     print(s)
> EOF

> import sys
> f=open('image.ppm','rb')
> f.read(15)
> data=f.read()
> w,h=800,600
> def px(x,y):
>     o=(y*w+x)*3
>     return data[o],data[o+1],data[o+2]
> # find red sphere box
> x0=y0=x1=y1=-1
> for y in range(h):
>     for x in range(w):
>         r,g,b=px(x,y)
>         if r>80 and r-b>40 and g<80:
>             if x0<0: x0=x0
>             if x0<0: x0=x
>             x0=min(x0,x) if x0>=0 else x
> # simpler:
> minx=miny=999; maxx=maxy=-1
> cnt=0
> for y in range(h):
>     for x in range(w):
>         r,g,b=px(x,y)
>         if r>80 and r-b>40 and g<80:
>             minx=min(minx,x);maxx=max(maxx,x)
>             miny=min(miny,y);maxy=max(maxy,y)
>             cnt+=1
> print('sphere box x',minx,maxx,'y',miny,maxy,'count',cnt)
> print('center',(minx+maxx)/2,(miny+maxy)/2,'rx',(maxx-minx)/2,'ry',(maxy-miny)/2)
> # horizon at column 200
> def is_sky(r,g,b):
>     return b>240 and abs(r-g)<40 and r<230
> yh=-1
> for y in range(h):
>     r,g,b=px(200,y)
>     if not is_sky(r,g,b):
>         yh=y;break
> print('horizon at col200 y=',yh)
> # sky vertical profile col 200
> print('col200 sky profile (y,R,G,B):')
> for y in range(0,yh,20):
>     print(y,px(200,y))
> # sky horizontal profile row 0
> print('row0 horiz (x,R,G,B):')
> for x in [0,100,200,300,400,500,600,700,799]:
>     print(x,px(x,0))
> EOF

root@a258f96ffde1:/app# cat > /tmp/m3.py << 'EOF'
> import sys
> f=open('image.ppm','rb'); f.read(15)
> data=f.read(); w,h=800,600
> def px(x,y):
>     o=(y*w+x)*3; return data[o],data[o+1],data[o+2]
> # horizon at several columns: first non-sky pixel
> def is_sky(r,g,b):
>     return b>245 and r<210 and g<210 and (r-g)<40 and (g-b)<-40
> def horizon(x):
>     for y in range(h):
>         r,g,b=px(x,y)
>         if not is_sky(r,g,b): return y
>     return -1
> for x in [10,200,400,600,790]:
>     print('col',x,'horizon y=',horizon(x))
> # sphere shading across center row y=312
> print('sphere horiz at y=312:')
> for x in range(375,461,5):
>     print(x,px(x,312))
> # checkerboard at bottom row y=560
> print('checker y=560 (luminance):')
> l=[(r+g+b)//3 for (r,g,b) in (px(x,560) for x in range(0,800,4))]
> print(l)
> EOF

root@a258f96ffde1:/app# cat > /tmp/m4.py << 'EOF'
> import sys
> f=open('image.ppm','rb'); f.read(15)
> data=f.read(); w,h=800,600
> def px(x,y):
>     o=(y*w+x)*3; return data[o],data[o+1],data[o+2]
> def is_sky(r,g,b):
>     return b==255 and r<g and g<255 and r>100
> # horizon curve at all columns (skip sphere x-range 360-480)
> hz={}
> for x in range(0,800):
>     hz[x]=-1
>     for y in range(h):
>         r,g,b=px(x,y)
>         if not is_sky(r,g,b):
>             hz[x]=y; break
> # print sampled
> print('x  horizonY')
> for x in range(0,800,40):
>     print(x,hz[x])
> # dir.y check at column 10
> print('col10 sky dir.y:')
> for y in range(0,200,20):
>     r,g,b=px(10,y)
>     t=(255-r)/127.5
>     print(y,'R',r,'t',round(t,3),'diry',round(2*t-1,3))
> # sphere box precise
> minx=miny=999;maxx=maxy=-1
> for y in range(h):
>     for x in range(w):
>         r,g,b=px(x,y)
>         if r>80 and r-b>40 and g<80:
>             minx=min(minx,x);maxx=max(maxx,x);miny=min(miny,y);maxy=max(maxy,y)
> print('sphere box x',minx,maxx,'y',miny,maxy)
> print('center x',(minx+maxx)/2,'y',(miny+maxy)/2,'rx',(maxx-minx)/2,'ry',(maxy-miny)/2)
> EOF
